title: Munarini graphs: a generalization of Fibonacci cubes and Pell graphs. Part I
summary: The Fibonacci cube $Γ_n$ is the subgraph of the hypercube $Q_n$ induced by vertices with no consecutive $1$s. Munarini introduced Pell graphs, a variation of Fibonacci cubes defined on ternary strings. A generalization of Pell graphs to $(k+1)$-ary strings has recently been proposed. In this paper we introduce Munarini graphs, which constitute an alternative generalization of Fibonacci cubes and Pell graphs.
